fields.description: The unit staff type package length, width and height in. CBM is derived from this — change it and every new receipt calculates differently.
fields.label: Package Dimension Unit

fields.description: Pre-selected on a new Receipt Note. Cargo type drives the storage rate.
fields.label: Default Cargo Type
Default Receipt Mode
fields.options:
Delivery at Warehouse
Collection from Customer

fields.label: Default Disposition
fields.options:
Move to Other Warehouse
Store at Same Warehouse

fields.description: The customer-facing number generated on submit. Frappe naming-series syntax, e.g. HSM-TRK-.YYYY.-.#####
fields.label: Tracking Number Series

fields.description: Block is safest. Warn only lets the receipt through and says so.
fields.label: When a warehouse would overflow
fields.options:
Block the receipt
Warn only
Do not check

fields.description: A Warehouse Unit whose total capacity is 0 has not had its size entered yet. With this ticked such a warehouse accepts goods instead of refusing everything.
fields.label: Treat zero capacity as not configured

fields.description: Shown on the Receipt Note as an amber warning.
fields.label: Warn above this utilisation

fields.description: Used when the origin warehouse has no default of its own.
fields.label: Fallback Mode of Transport

fields.description: The non-stock service item storage is invoiced on. Created automatically if it does not exist.
fields.label: Storage Service Item

fields.description: The billable unit, one cubic metre for one day. Must allow fractions — a whole-number UOM makes every storage invoice fail.
fields.label: Storage UOM

fields.description: Decides what the customer pays. Goods in on the 1st and out on the 12th are 12 days inclusive, or 11 charging only the day in.
fields.label: How storage days are counted
fields.options:
Both days inclusive
Charge the day in, not the day out
Exclude both days

fields.description: A stay shorter than this is billed as this many days. Zero for no minimum.
fields.label: Minimum Chargeable Days

fields.description: Creates Storage Charges for the previous month. It never creates an invoice — that stays a human action.
fields.label: Accrue storage automatically each month

fields.description: Report and skip lets the rest of the month accrue and logs the gap. Either way it is never billed at zero.
fields.label: When a customer has no storage rate
